section_summary.extract_value: This Construct Validity section reports that the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) correlates positively with appearance evaluation (MBSRQ-AE) and general self-esteem (RSES), and negatively with measures including Western beauty internalization, dieting, weight-related teasing, BMI, and several eating-disorder symptom scales. The text refers readers to Table 3 for the correlations but Table 3 is not provided here, and no numeric correlation coefficients or sample details are given in the supplied text.
